+def _normalize_name(name: str) -> str:
+    """Normalize parameter name by removing leading asterisks.
+    
+    This is used to match parameter names in docstrings (which may have
+    asterisks like *args or **kwargs) with parameter names in signatures
+    (which don't have asterisks).
+    """
+    return name.lstrip('*')
+
+
 def record_typehints(app: Sphinx, objtype: str, name: str, obj: Any,
                      options: Dict, args: str, retann: str) -> None:
